scope: Official-source desktop research for pending strategy-c-ubuntu API/worker experiments; no candidate execution performed in this review
sources_policy: Only Canonical/Ubuntu official pages and Canonical-owned repository were used as evidence. Search-index versus individual-page differences and fetch limitations are explicit.

support.component_caveat: Standard LTS security support covers Main/Restricted for five years; Universe/Multiverse have community support unless relevant Ubuntu Pro coverage applies. Do not assume every installed dependency has identical support.

python.interpretation: Ubuntu fixes supported packages through backported security patches and distro revisions. A lower upstream patch banner than python:3.12.16 is not evidence of an unmaintained downgrade. Assess distro package revision and CVE status; do not claim all upstream fixes or behavior are equivalent.
python.venv_component_caveat: Official package index marks python3.12-venv Universe; inspect actual dependency support instead of applying Main claim to all artifacts.
